name: 20261031-ppo-small-100ppo-32minibatches
rollout_storage: lossless packed RAM: float32 numerics, packed binary flags, uint16 card IDs
evaluation_policy: stochastic, fixed evaluation seed, isolated from training RNG
precision: FP32 parameters, gradients and Adam; matmul precision high permits TF32; no BF16 autocast

paper_alignment.scope: local next-version configuration, not a reproduction of the paper early/final budget
paper_alignment.learning_rate: user-selected 3e-4, linearly decays to the previously discussed 3e-6 floor
paper_alignment.epochs: 1, retains the executed baseline and user preference; 2 epochs was an unexecuted earlier candidate

budget_definition: 100 PPO iterations; each rollout has 32 effective minibatches per epoch; epochs=1

model_retention_policy.selection: fixed-seed evaluation mean placement; earliest wins ties
model_retention_policy.after_evaluation: retain best_model.zip only for this experiment
model_retention_policy.records: keep metrics, evaluation JSON, TensorBoard, source hashes and cleanup manifest
model_retention_policy.note: training entry point writes temporary models; retention is a separate post-evaluation step
